usedFor: Clarifai recognizes what is in images, and “Add Image Input” adds an image URL as a new input.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Image Input” in Clarifai
bestTemplate.why: It is the one action here, and it gets a new image URL into Clarifai.

watchOut: “Add Image Input” in Clarifai needs an image URL, so an earlier step must pass one.
